long_biography.plain_text:
RCI Holding grew from the consulting platform Dan Stratan established in Bucharest in 2000. He brought experience from Merrill Lynch International, where he worked across debt capital markets, equities and mergers and acquisitions. He applied that finance background to advisory businesses serving infrastructure and utilities.

The holding now brings together specialist companies in energy markets, consulting engineering, management consulting and digital innovation. Its model combines technical and commercial advice for major projects rather than owning the capital expenditure those projects represent. Stratan continues to direct the group as founder and chief executive, overseeing regional expansion and acquisitions such as the integration of digital agency Grapefruit.

uncertainties.detail: Current first-party sources usually shorten the name to Dan Stratan. Older corporate reporting uses Dan Iulian Stratan and connects that exact name to the same Romcapital platform, Iași origin and Romanian business identity. The exact-name World Rowing record independently supplies Romanian nationality and the corroborated birth year.
The birth year 1962 is strongly supported by exact-name business reporting and World Rowing. No sufficiently reliable source reviewed supplied a birth day or month, so neither is proposed.

RCI Holding operates across energy markets, engineering, digital technology and management consulting. Professional services form the majority of its disclosed turnover and tie these practices together, supporting Service as the current principal industry rather than Energy or Diversified.

RCI Holding reports group turnover and the capital expenditure of projects its teams manage. Those are corporate and client-project measures, not Stratan's personal assets or net worth, and the dossier does not convert them into a personal wealth estimate.

No identity-secure personal LinkedIn, Instagram or personal website was found. The official RCI Holding company page is proposed only under the Company Website type because current sources establish Stratan's founder, owner and leadership relationship.

Politics, controversies, allegations, legal matters, sanctions, irrelevant private-family detail and all private-vessel research were excluded. None contributes to the identity, classification or biography claims.
